name: Should I hire a general contractor or a handyman for home repairs?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or a handyman for home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a licensed general contractor is better when repairs cross multiple trades or involve structural components, while a standard handyman is suited for quick, isolated tasks. If your maintenance involves repairing drywall after a plumbing leak, fixing subflooring under loose bathroom tile, or repairing structural framing, a general contractor coordinates the trades under one roof. The practical tradeoff is that a general contractor may require scheduling around multi-step phases, but you avoid managing separate painters, carpenters, and specialty trades yourself while ensuring the work meets building standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor when repairs involve multiple trades like drywall, tile, and plumbing coordination. Use a handyman for simple, isolated fixes.
